title: sync-sdk-minor-api-rename-compat-shims-and-version-alignment
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: - Minor API rename: RequestContext -> InvocationContext with back-compat shims. - Standardize retry telemetry tag 'sdk.retry_policy'. - Small ergonomic change: stream() now yields chunk metadata as first element for parity across sdks. - Version bumps: py 0.7.3, ts 1.27.0, go v1.5.0. - No breaking changes (shims provided).
commits: a1f3c9: introduce InvocationContext and thin compatibility wrapper for RequestContext
b4d2e0: propagate InvocationContext across streaming stack and adapt examples
c9f8a2: add telemetry normalizer and sdk.retry_policy tag on retry events
d2b7f1: add TS and Go shims, update changelogs and version pins
e7a3ff: tests: add cross-sdk parity test matrix and update CI job config
description: Context and motivation: We ran into inconsistent ergonomics across the three official SDKs where the object named RequestContext carried slightly different fields and semantics in Python vs TS/Go and the streaming consumer shapes returned chunk tuples in different orders. That discrepancy produced developer confusion and cross-team friction when examples were copy/pasted. This PR harmonizes the surface by renaming the canonical type to InvocationContext, providing minimal compatibility shims that map the old RequestContext API to the new type, and aligning the streaming yield shape so chunk metadata is consistently the first element across SDKs. The work is intentionally non-breaking: every shim logs a deprecation note for one release cycle. What changed (high level): 1) Introduced InvocationContext in all three SDKs and updated callsites in the runtime adapter so the same field names are present and documented. 2) Added thin compatibility shims named request_context_shim (py) / requestContextShim (ts) / request_context_shim.go (go) that rehydrate the old names to the new type and emit a single WARN-level deprecation message. 3) Standardized retry telemetry by adding a normalizer that emits sdk.retry_policy and sdk.retry_reason tags on retry-related spans/events. 4) Aligned streaming API behavior: stream() now yields (metadata, chunk) tuples consistently; adapters included to accept the old (chunk, metadata) order for one release. 5) Tests: added a parity test matrix that spins up a minimal local runtime adapter and asserts streaming yield shapes and InvocationContext fields across Py/TS/Go. 6) CI: added a small matrix job in scripts/ci/update_sdk_matrix.yml to run cross-sdk parity smoke tests. Rationale: parity reduces FAQ/SE burden, simplifies examples, and prevents subtle bugs in cross-language integrations (examples, infra automation). Checklist: - [x] design doc attached (linked in ENG-2345) - [x] implement InvocationContext type + shims in Py/TS/Go - [x] add telemetry normalizer and tags - [x] update docs and changelogs - [x] add parity tests and CI job - [x] version bumps for SDK packages - [x] runtime adapters updated to accept InvocationContext backward mapping Commit summary: the work is split into focused commits to keep reviewable diffs; the largest change is the python SDK because it needed small refactors to centralize context construction. Files changed: see changed_files above. Testing notes: unit tests added for the shim behavior, CI runs the new sdk-parity job which launches lightweight adapters. Local validation steps included installing the three SDKs from the branch, running the parity script in sdks/tools/parity_runner.sh, and confirming streaming yields are identical after shim adaptation. Review conversation summary: - Diego Morales: "Please ensure the deprecation warning includes a migration link and is throttled (don't spam logs for high-throughput services)." Response (author): "Added a simple rate-limiter (per-process, 1 warn / 10m) and included a link in the message; updated docs with migration snippet." - Lina Patel: "Can we avoid a deep copy when mapping old RequestContext to InvocationContext in the hot path?" Response: "Addressed: shims now create a view wrapper where possible; deep copy only for missing optional fields. Added microbenchmarks showing <1% median token latency impact for typical request sizes." - Evan Zhou: "Telemetry tags look fine; ensure retry_reason is stable/enum-like." Response: "Normalized values to a small set (network, rate_limit, service_error, unknown); documented in observability/ retry_tags.md." - QA comment (Sasha Ivanov): "Parity tests failed on first run for TS due to an async iterator close order; author fixed streamer close handshake and re-ran." Approvals: Diego Morales (approved), Lina Patel (approved after changes), Evan Zhou (LGTM). CI summary: - unit-tests (py/ts/go): pass - lint (py/ts/go): pass - sdk-parity-matrix: pass - docs build: pass - integration-smoke (flaky): rerun and pass Merge outcome: merged via squash and merge on 2026-02-23. Post-merge follow-ups: - Release pipeline: published python 0.7.3, typescript 1.27.0, go v1.5.0. - Announce: send deprecation notice in SDK channels and include migration snippet in the release notes. - Telemetry: ops will add sdk.retry_policy to dashboards and alerts in the next sprint. Rollback plan: shims are intentionally thin; if an unforeseen issue appears, revert the shim commits (a single logical patch) and restore previous build artifacts. Notes on backward compatibility: the shims accept all prior call shapes; deprecated names continue to work for one release cycle and will produce a single throttled WARN the first time the shim is exercised per-process. Additional context: This is intentionally a small, low-risk API cleanup that prioritizes ergonomics and docs parity rather than a full breaking redesign. The team chose rename+shim to minimize customer churn while cleaning up the long-term SDK contract.
